rationale_text: Case 10257_1000261: a 0.22 cc lesion in the peripheral zone is moderately hypointense on T2W (z=-1.19 relative to same-zone background tissue) with round to oval, more circumscribed (sphericity=0.70) margins. A substantial portion of the lesion falls outside the automated whole-gland segmentation, suggestive of extraprostatic extension (note: the gland mask is AI-derived and not verified at the capsule boundary, so this may partly reflect gland-segmentation imprecision rather than confirmed extension). These measurements are consistent with PI-RADS category 3. Note: this dataset is biparametric (no DCE sequence available); real PI-RADS v2.1 would use DCE as a tie-breaker for a peripheral-zone category-3 lesion (early enhancement can upgrade PZ-3 to PZ-4) -- that assessment cannot be made here, so this category should be treated as a lower bound, not a confirmed 3.
